source_coverage_note: Full 115-paragraph canonical lecture read end-to-end. Direct Blake lines and other external wording were excluded from Neville attribution regardless of quality. Two clean Neville-only formulations survive: the pilgrim-through-states analogy and a compact statement of loyalty to an imaginal act. Blake-dependent paraphrase, mystical/religious interpretation, postmortem claims, control-of-others language, universal causation, scripture, anecdotes, and weaker overlaps remain HOLD/DROP.
